Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
I already submitted  a version 5 years ago , but every time I think about building a Tzimisce deck with big vampires, I'm facing the same problems: how can I bring them in play relatively fast without dying.

Name: Cathedral of Flesh
Cardtype: Master
Cost: 1 pool
Clan: Tzimisce
Remove a ready Tzimisce you control from the game to add X blood to an older Tzimisce in your uncontrolled region, where X is the capacity of the removed Tzimisce.

World of Darkness reference: whitewolf.wikia.com/wiki/Cathedral_of_Flesh

How does this card address a compelling game need?: With the exception of Lambach and Sha-Ennu, Tzimisce of cap 9+ are very rarely played because they can't govern down and doesn't have synergy with crypt accelerators such as Zillah's Valley.
Velya, The Flayer
Szechenyi Jolan, Mother of Horrors

Stravinsky

The card is designed to recycle your worn out small Tzimisce into older Tzimisce you wouldn't play otherwise.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Hakuron wrote:
> I don't see "it only goes off once", but I see a "usable any time".
>
> Or is there something in the original wording I understand wrong?
>
It doesn't get into play (it's not a location for instance). You just play it like a Golconda.

> Hakuron wrote:
> And I don't why a permanent Social Ladder (or something stronger) should be weak.
>
For two reasons: the first one is that you need to remove vampires from play, and have vampires in your uncontrolled region. That means you wouldn't use it more than twice in a game.
The second reason is that to be efficient, you need blood on the vampire you're removing. But if they have blood, you probably don't want to remove them from play but play with them. In my proposal, you only consider the capacity, so you can remove worn out vampires to get a new bigger one (though it costs you 1 pool, and the missing pool to influence the vampire out).

Messages.Author: jamesatzephyr
Messages.Body:
> Ankha wrote:
> Name: Cathedral of Flesh
> Cardtype: Master
> Cost: 1 pool
> Clan: Tzimisce
> Remove a ready Tzimisce you control from the game to add X blood to an older Tzimisce in your uncontrolled region, where X is the capacity of the removed Tzimisce.
>
I think in terms of fitting an interesting niche for accelerating Tzimisce, and the power level, it's potentially quite interesting.

What I'm not wild about is the implementation from the point of view of it feeling like yet another reason to play Villein in combos with other master cards. I mean, obviously, it's different from Villein+Giant's Blood in that you don't get a full vampire to use right away, but you could be pulling 4 or 5 pool back from a full vampire, then getting 4 or 5 pool free onto your big Tzimisce, and not necessarily being restricted to doing it once per game. Perhaps it's something you might plan to do mid-game too, when you're not using so many transfers - flip out a vampire you don't care about so much, to Villein all his blood back and Flesh him too. And of course you can be playing Villein+Giant's Blood in the deck too.

I think it might be nice if, somehow, it was possible to retain roughly the same utility and power level, without quite so much potential synergy with cards that are already really very, very good indeed. Given the way it works, it just seems like it would be bad play _not_ to plan to (try to) empty your Lolita or Devin before shmushing their corpse into a fattie.

Messages.Author: jamesatzephyr
Messages.Body:
> Ankha wrote:
> In that case, a slight ajustment is easy to make:
>
> Name: Cathedral of Flesh
> Cardtype: Master
> Cost: 1 pool
> Clan: Tzimisce
> Remove a ready Tzimisce you control from the game to add X blood to an older Tzimisce in your uncontrolled region, where X is the capacity of the removed Tzimisce. Each Methuselah can play only one Cathedral of Flesh in a game.
>
> Or stop it from being played while the older Tzimisce is still in play.
>
Significant restrictions on how frequently you can play it - once per game, one per Methuselah per game, a Gather-like Unique mechanic, or whatever - are likely to undermine the effect you originally wanted: being able to bring out a small vampire for early defensive purposes etc., knowing you're not totally shooting yourself in the foot when you want to bring out Sha-Ennu. With such severe restrictions, it's harder to load your deck with more than one or two of them, so the chances of you ever having one early in a game are much lower.

I was thinking, perhaps, something inspired by a souped-up version of Grooming the Protege. Or perhaps something that's a little weaker in terms of the acceleration, but with an alternative use later to bolster the fatty. Say something like...

Cathedral of Flesh
Requires: Tzimisce
Master: trifle.
If you do not control any Tzimisce with a capacity above 6, gain +3 transfers during your influence phase this turn. Otherwise, move 2 blood from the blood bank to your oldest ready Tzimisce. You cannot play another Cathedral of Flesh this turn.

It's doesn't feel quite right, but it's in the sort of area I'm thinking of - the later blood gain is intended to make it playable and to offset the fact that you only get additional transfers early on, not free blood. I think something like this might be more playable, and - by being a trifle - isn't jostling quite so hard to oust Pentex Subversion, Giant's Blood, Dreams of the Sphinx or Direct Intervention from your deck.

(I wonder if it's sufficient to power some sort of weenie deck, with 7 transfers a turn - possibly 9 with Info Highway - to draw and flip-out weenies. Hmm.)

Messages.Author: GreyB
Messages.Body:
> Ankha wrote:
> Name: Cathedral of Flesh
> Cardtype: Master
> Cost: 1 pool
> Clan: Tzimisce
> Remove a ready Tzimisce you control from the game to add X blood to an older Tzimisce in your uncontrolled region, where X is the capacity of the removed Tzimisce.
>
It is (ab)usable for pool gain and I can see several scenarios where you can create a very gruesome overpowered wall deck. Here's an attempt to remove the pool gain component.

Burn a Tzimisce you control of at least 5 capacity and put this card on a Tzimisce in your uncontrolled region. Burn this card in your next influence phase and move that Tzimisce to your controlled region with 0 blood.

It keeps the blood/pool counters, as in it does not add more counters to the table with villein shenanigans, whilst still doing what you initially intended (perhaps slightly better). You can still trade in a expended (or torporized) Tzimisce for an older better Tzimisce. There's even an opportunity to weave in Soul gem of Etrius.

-1 Strength

Messages.Author: TwoRazorReign
Messages.Body:
I think I like this combo effect:

Build a crypt with 4 X Little Tailor of Prague (8 cap), 4X Stravinsky (9 cap), and 4X Lambach (10 cap). Influence out Stravinsky. Equip with Soul Gem. Cathedral of Flesh during influence phase. Influence out Lambach and (hopefully) Soul Gem out Little Tailor too.

There's some big holes with this premise. Either it'll pay off big or not work at all. It's risky, but fun when it works. That's how combo effects should be. The backup plan would be to influence out Lambach and Govern.

I'm not sure the intent of the card was to make a Lambach deck potentially better, because dominate. Still, I think the combo effect is crappy enough where the card is not really making that deck better.
